title: PeerHealthState missing #[derive(Debug)]
description: PeerHealthState has fields Vec<(SmtpRelayPeerConfig, PeerStatus)>, usize, Duration — all implement Debug (SmtpRelayPeerConfig has a manual Debug impl redacting password, PeerStatus derives Debug). Yet PeerHealthState has no Debug impl. This prevents SmtpRelayQueue from deriving Debug and makes PeerHealthState impossible to print in log/assert contexts. Add #[derive(Debug)] to PeerHealthState.
